description: A tea light holder carved by hand from a single piece of natural Himalayan pink salt. When the candle is lit, the salt glows a soft, warm amber, adding a calm, cosy light to a living room, bedroom, bathroom or yoga corner.

Because each one is cut from natural salt crystal, no two are exactly alike: the colour, texture and shape vary a little from piece to piece, so yours is one of a kind. It comes with a candle, so it is ready to light, and makes a thoughtful gift.
details: Hand-carved from natural Himalayan pink salt
Comes with one candle (the style of candle varies)
Holds one tea light, flameless LED tea light or small votive at a time
Each holder is unique, so the colour, shape and size vary slightly from the photos
One candle holder per order. The other holders, gift box and items shown in the photos are not included
Keep it somewhere dry, as salt can absorb moisture from damp air
Never leave a burning candle unattended, and keep it away from anything that can catch fire
